title: Multi-Step Word Problems, Graphs and Data Interpretation

questions.question: A coach can carry 48 passengers. Three coaches are completely full, and a fourth coach carries 37 passengers. How many passengers are travelling altogether?
questions.explanation: Three full coaches carry 48 × 3 = 144 passengers. Then 144 + 37 = 181.

questions.question: An adult ticket costs £8.50 and a child ticket costs £5.25. A family buys 2 adult tickets and 3 child tickets. How much do they pay altogether?
questions.explanation: Two adults cost £17.00 and three children cost £15.75. The total is £32.75.

questions.question: Lena reads 18 pages each day from Monday to Thursday. On Friday, she reads 27 pages. How many pages does she read altogether?
questions.explanation: Monday to Thursday is four days, so 18 × 4 = 72. Then 72 + 27 = 99.

questions.question: A shop has 240 apples. It sells 85 apples in the morning and 67 apples in the afternoon. How many apples remain?
Adam read 7 books, Bella 12, Cara 9, Daniel 15 and Ella 11. How many books did the five pupils read altogether?
Daniel read 15 books and Adam read 7. How many more books did Daniel read than Adam?
Bella read 12 books and Ella read 11. Their books are packed equally into two boxes. How many books go into each box?
A swimming pool contains 1,500 litres of water. During cleaning, 275 litres are removed. Then 180 litres are added. How much water is now in the pool?
A group plans to walk 24 kilometres. They walk 7.5 km before lunch and 8.25 km after lunch. How much farther must they walk?
questions.explanation: They have walked 7.5 + 8.25 = 15.75 km. Then 24 - 15.75 = 8.25 km.

questions.question: A factory packs 36 bottles into each box. It fills 8 boxes, but 17 bottles are later found to be damaged. How many undamaged bottles remain?
